response.sql: WITH patient_avg AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_mean FROM patient_avg) SELECT pa.SEX, AVG(pa.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(pa.avg_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(pa.avg_diff / o.overall_mean) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_avg pa CROSS JOIN overall o GROUP BY pa.SEX;
